{{Top|leg}}
'''Command bunker 2''' was a heavily fortified defense bunker on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] built by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]]. The reasoning behind its construction was simple; in the event they were ever under attack and needed to mount a defense, they would have a safe location to do so. It was apparently built after the first [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], and was used during the second later battle. It was a fall-back position in case [[Command bunker 1|Command Bunker 1]] was overrun by enemy troops.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' there is a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] in the same location that Command bunker 2 is located in ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]'' It is possible that the hangar was destroyed during the Battle of Geonosis, and in the years following the battle the Geonosians built Command bunker 2 in its place.
